basic_info.description: Welcome to this charming single-family home, full of potential and ready for its next chapter. The main level boasts an unusually spacious formal living and dining room, a bright and airy kitchen with access to a private patio, plus two comfortable bedrooms and a full bath with a separate water closet.    The lower level features full-height ceilings from front to back, creating an open and inviting feel. This level offers a large one-car garage, two generously sized finished rooms(unwarranted w/ potential for bedrooms) with ample closets, a full bath, and abundant storage. Enjoy seamless indoor-outdoor living with direct access to a spacious deck and expansive rear yardperfect for gatherings, play, or quiet relaxation.    Lovingly cared for by the same family for over 50 years, this home is ready to be refreshed with a touch of TLC. Ideally located near public transportation, including Tech shuttles, and just moments from shopping and vibrant dining districts, it offers both convenience and opportunity.
